meta.title: Enterprise Transformation Portfolio
meta.source: IT_Transformation_Programme_Portfolio.xlsx (Portfolio Data sheet). Milestones are illustrative demonstration data.

projects.name: Identity Governance Cloud Transformation
projects.scope: Migrate IGA to a cloud operating model, strengthen identity lifecycle management, integrations, governance and access reviews.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: IGA Cloud Tenant Configured
milestones.description: SailPoint ISC tenant and Entra ID / SAP E1 connectors configured in non-production.

milestones.name: Joiner-Mover-Leaver Automation Live
milestones.description: Identity lifecycle workflows automated through REST API integrations.

milestones.name: First Cloud Access Review Campaign
milestones.description: RBAC-based access review campaign run on the cloud IGA platform; legacy IGA retirement approved.

projects.name: Privileged Access Management Cloud Transformation
projects.scope: Transform PAM to a cloud operating model, including JIT privileged access, session control and secrets management.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: PAM Target Architecture Approved
milestones.description: CyberArk cloud design, including JIT and Entra PIM integration, approved by the design authority.

milestones.name: JIT Privileged Access Pilot
milestones.description: Just-in-time elevation and privileged session recording piloted with Tier 0 administrators.

milestones.name: Privileged Accounts Onboarded
milestones.description: In-scope privileged accounts and secrets vaulted, with MFA enforced for all privileged sessions.

projects.name: Enterprise SIEM & Security Operations Transformation
projects.scope: Phase I: replace the enterprise SIEM. Phase II: introduce security automation, response orchestration and enhanced detection use cases.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Phase I platform replacement and Phase II automation are aligned under a single transformation roadmap.

milestones.name: SIEM Platform Selected & Log Sources Mapped
milestones.description: Replacement SIEM selected; priority log sources and ingestion approach agreed.

milestones.name: Phase I SIEM Cutover
milestones.description: Legacy SIEM retired; detection content migrated and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

milestones.name: SOAR Playbooks in Production
milestones.description: Phase II response orchestration live for priority incident response use cases.

projects.name: Enterprise Directory Transformation – AD to Entra ID, Phase I
projects.scope: Deliver Phase I of the transformation from traditional Active Directory towards a cloud identity model and reduce dependency on on-premises directory services.
projects.ragCommentary: Legacy application dependencies and hybrid identity complexity are affecting migration sequencing; remediation plan is in progress.

milestones.name: Hybrid Identity Assessment Complete
milestones.description: Active Directory dependencies, Group Policy estate and hybrid identity flows inventoried.

milestones.name: Legacy Application Remediation – Wave 1
milestones.description: First wave of AD-dependent applications remediated; sequencing affected by legacy dependencies.

milestones.name: Phase I Cloud Identity Cutover
milestones.description: Conditional Access, MFA and FIDO2 enforced for Phase I user populations on Entra ID.

projects.name: Global Network Segmentation & Firewall Transformation
projects.scope: Segment the enterprise network, redesign security zones, rationalise firewall policies and reduce legacy network dependencies.
projects.ragCommentary: Firewall rule complexity and site-specific dependencies require additional remediation before full segmentation can be completed.

milestones.name: Security Zone Design Approved
milestones.description: Target security zones, VLAN model and segmentation principles approved.

milestones.name: Firewall Policy Rationalisation
milestones.description: Legacy firewall rules rationalised; site-specific dependencies require additional remediation.

milestones.name: Segmentation Complete at Strategic Sites
milestones.description: Segmented zones and NAC enforced at strategic sites; legacy flat networks retired.

projects.name: IT Service Management Platform Transformation – ServiceNow to Jira SM
projects.scope: Migrate core ITSM capabilities from ServiceNow to Jira Service Management, covering Incident, Request, Change, Knowledge and Service Catalogue.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Core process migration and service catalogue transition remain within the planned four-month delivery window.

milestones.name: Service Catalogue Mapped to Jira SM
milestones.description: ServiceNow catalogue items, request types and SLAs mapped to Jira Service Management.

milestones.name: CMDB Migrated to Jira Assets
milestones.description: Configuration items migrated from ServiceNow and reconciled in Jira Assets; UAT signed off.

milestones.name: Jira Service Management Go-Live
milestones.description: Incident, Request, Change and Knowledge live on Jira SM; ServiceNow set to read-only.

projects.name: Enterprise Endpoint Protection & EDR Consolidation
projects.scope: Consolidate endpoint protection and EDR/XDR capabilities, improve hardening standards and retire legacy endpoint agents.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Defender for Endpoint Pilot
milestones.description: EDR/XDR pilot completed across representative Windows device groups.

milestones.name: Intune Hardening Baselines Enforced
milestones.description: Device compliance and hardening baselines enforced through Microsoft Intune.

milestones.name: Legacy Endpoint Agents Retired
milestones.description: Consolidated Defender stack in production; legacy endpoint agents removed.

projects.name: Cloud Security Posture & Guardrails Implementation
projects.scope: Implement cloud security baselines, automated guardrails, posture management and compliance monitoring across strategic cloud platforms.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Cloud Security Baseline Approved
milestones.description: Security baselines for Azure and AWS approved against NIS2 and ISO 27001 controls.

milestones.name: Policy-as-Code Guardrails Deployed
milestones.description: Automated preventive guardrails deployed through Terraform pipelines.

milestones.name: CSPM Compliance Monitoring Live
milestones.description: Posture management and continuous compliance monitoring live across strategic cloud platforms.

projects.name: Enterprise Access Certification & Application Governance
projects.scope: Standardise application ownership, access certification, role models, segregation-of-duties controls and recurring access reviews.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Application Ownership Register Complete
milestones.description: Business and technical owners confirmed for all in-scope applications.

milestones.name: SoD Rule Set Implemented
milestones.description: Segregation-of-duties rules for SAP E1 and key applications implemented in SailPoint.

milestones.name: First Enterprise Recertification Cycle
milestones.description: Enterprise-wide access recertification completed with audit evidence retained.

projects.name: Zero Trust Access Transformation with Zscaler
projects.scope: Transform remote, administrative and third-party access towards identity-aware Zero Trust access and reduce reliance on traditional VPN.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: ZPA Pilot for Administrative Access
milestones.description: Zscaler Private Access piloted for administrative access with device posture checks.

milestones.name: Third-Party Access Migrated
milestones.description: Supplier and third-party access moved to identity-aware Zero Trust access policies.

milestones.name: VPN Retired for Remote Users
milestones.description: Remote user access served through ZPA/ZIA; traditional VPN decommissioned.

projects.name: Machine Identity & Secrets Management – Discovery and Phase I
projects.scope: Perform enterprise discovery of service accounts, API keys and certificates, followed by Phase I onboarding and automated secrets rotation.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Discovery scope is defined and Phase I onboarding criteria are being prepared.

milestones.name: Machine Identity Discovery Complete
milestones.description: Service accounts, API keys and certificates discovered and ownership assigned.

milestones.name: Phase I Vault Onboarding
milestones.description: Priority service accounts and secrets onboarded to CyberArk vaulting.

milestones.name: Automated Secrets Rotation Live
milestones.description: Automated rotation in place for Phase I secrets and PKI certificates.

projects.name: Global IT Operating Model & Process Transformation
projects.scope: Standardise global IT processes, ownership, governance, RACI, KPI, escalation models and the global/local operating model.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Target operating model and process ownership principles are progressing to plan.

milestones.name: Target Operating Model Approved
milestones.description: Global/local operating model, RACI and governance forums approved.

milestones.name: KPI & SLA Framework Baselined
milestones.description: Process KPIs, SLAs and escalation model baselined in Jira Service Management.

milestones.name: Global Operating Model Live
milestones.description: Global process ownership and continual improvement cycle operating across regions.

projects.name: Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform Transformation
projects.scope: Modernise the enterprise data platform, standardise data models, consolidate reporting and migrate legacy analytics to a modern architecture.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Target data architecture and migration waves are aligned with the planned 2028 transformation roadmap.

milestones.name: Target Data Architecture Signed Off
milestones.description: Snowflake-based target architecture and migration waves signed off.

milestones.name: Semantic Layer & Data Catalogue Live
milestones.description: Standard data models, semantic layer and data catalogue available to reporting teams.

milestones.name: Legacy Analytics Migrated
milestones.description: Legacy reports consolidated into Power BI on the modern data platform.

projects.name: Global CRM & Customer Experience Platform Transformation
projects.scope: Transform the CRM and customer experience platform, integrate customer data, modernise the frontend and deliver a phased market rollout.
projects.ragCommentary: CRM integration complexity and market rollout dependencies are under active review; delivery remains recoverable within the programme window.

milestones.name: CRM Solution Design & Integration Blueprint
milestones.description: Target CRM design and SAP E1 / REST API integration blueprint approved.

milestones.name: Customer Data Integration Complete
milestones.description: Customer data integration under review due to CRM integration complexity.

milestones.name: Phased Market Rollout Complete
milestones.description: CRM and modernised frontend rolled out to all planned markets.

projects.name: New Call Centre Onboarding & Operational Readiness
projects.scope: Onboard a new call centre, covering office readiness, IT infrastructure, telephony/contact-centre capabilities, workplaces, CRM access, training and cutover.
projects.ragCommentary: Vendor delay in office fit-out and preparation of the call centre premises is impacting infrastructure installation, workplace readiness and planned onboarding dates.

milestones.name: Premises Handover from Fit-out Vendor
milestones.description: Handover of call centre premises delayed by the fit-out vendor; recovery plan requested.

milestones.name: Infrastructure & Telephony Installed
milestones.description: LAN/WAN, workplaces, CCaaS telephony and IVR installation dependent on premises readiness.

milestones.name: Agent Onboarding & Cutover
milestones.description: Agents trained with CRM access; operational cutover to the new call centre.
